question: Can an E8 extension of the folded source bilinear currents carry the source Ward marking q/2 and a unique vacuum under the original fold time law?
summary_de: Nein in der Klasse der E8-Gitter, die die gefaltete D8 enthalten: q/2 liegt nur in E8_s; E8_s hat fuer jedes alpha den Nullzustand p*=(1/2^4,-1/2^4), geschuetzt gegen jede U(1)-Verdrillung (p*.q=0, Deck-Partnerabstand 1/2) und invariant unter g, g^2, g^4; E8_c hat eindeutiges Vakuum, aber keine Ward-Markierung. Rueckzug h -> h^2, Deck-Sektoren h und -h bestaetigt.
kills: An E8 extension of the folded source currents with unchanged fold time law has both the Ward marking q/2 and a unique vacuum
Gauging U(1)_q, the fold clock or the deck removes the s-chiral zero-energy state p*
The c-chiral rescue keeps the source Ward marking
assumptions: E8 extension contains the D8 bilinear roots of the eight fold channels
Fold time law K = |p|^2/2 + delta.p, delta_k = (k+alpha)/8 - 1/2 (Codex)
Ward marking: q/2 is a lattice vector (Codex, Q' = 2(e3+e6))
not_derived: E8 lattices not containing the fold D8 (triality frame) and their source map
